data.exact_reserve_text: During 2021 the syndicate released prior year reserves of $33.1m (2020: $16.5m). The syndicate's Marine, Property and Specialty Lines divisions all produced large releases on the 2019 underwriting year while Cyber & Executive Risk produced a net release of $4.4m despite an increase in ransomware claims activity on the 2020 underwriting year. The syndicate has taken action in the Property division to remediate selected areas of the account, including the entering into a 90% Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) of the divisions Engineering classes in March 2021, contributing to the release of $9.0m in the division.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a prior-year reserve release in 2021 of $33.1m (2020: $16.5m), driven primarily by favourable claims development across Marine, Property and Specialty Lines and by portfolio remediation including a 90% Loss Portfolio Transfer in the Property engineering classes which contributed materially to releases. Cyber also produced a release despite increased ransomware activity. A small adverse movement occurred in Political, Accident & Contingency. The opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 was $949.5m and the prior-year releases represent approximately a 3.5% reduction of that opening reserve base.

The syndicate has taken action in the Property division to remediate selected areas of the account, including the entering into a 90% Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) of the divisions Engineering classes in March 2021, contributing to the release of $9.0m in the division.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves and movement figures are taken from the syndicate balance sheet and the Managing Agent narrative respectively and are reported in the syndicate functional currency (USD millions). The document explicitly states 'released prior year reserves of $33.1m' but does not unambiguously label these releases as gross or net; the technical provisions note and segmental table support that this $33.1m figure is the syndicate's reported prior-year release (presented before any line-by-line reinsurance breakout). The claims development triangle is present in the technical provisions but absolute development-period rows (e.g., 'At end of underwriting year', 'One year later' as amounts) are not provided in explicit numeric form - only percentages by development age and current ultimate amounts are shown, so a full numeric development matrix was not reproducible from the report without further actuarial calculations.

_claims_triangle.notes: The report includes gross ultimate losses and gross outstanding claims by underwriting year (current ultimate and outstanding balances) and a percentage development table by development age. However, explicit absolute numeric rows for 'At end of underwriting year', 'One year later', etc. (development period numeric rows) are not presented as separate absolute amounts in the text - only percentage development tables and current ultimate totals are provided. Therefore the development_rows array is left empty; the triangle is available in part (current ultimate, paid and outstanding) on page 53.
